authz.tels.description.accept-or-reject-: Accept or reject library updates in Studio.
Accept or reject pending updates from content libraries linked to this course.
authz.tels.description.access-and-edit-t: Access and edit the Advanced Settings page in Studio. This covers a wide range of technical course configurations, including proctoring, timed exams, LTI tools, enrollment limits, and custom display options.
authz.tels.description.add-change-or-rem: Add, change, or remove role assignments for this course from the Roles and Permissions console.
Add, change, or remove role assignments for this library from the Roles and Permissions console.
authz.tels.description.add-or-remove-con: Add or remove content from existing collections.
authz.tels.description.add-or-remove-tag: Add or remove tags from content.
authz.tels.description.add-published-con: Add published content from this library to a course.
authz.tels.description.add-remove-and-as: Add, remove, and assign roles to users within the library.
authz.tels.description.additional-permis: Additional permissions not included in other categories, such as viewing checklists and platform-level course roles.
authz.tels.description.allow-course-or-l: Allow course or library admins to view the list of global Staff and Super Admin users.
authz.tels.description.allows-the-user-t: Allows the user to delete the library and all its contents.
Allows the user to publish the library and all its contents.
authz.tels.description.building-and-main: building and maintaining course content and supporting assets, without operational controls or high impact actions that can affect a live course.
authz.tels.description.can-create-and-ed: Can create and edit course content, but cannot publish or change critical course settings.
authz.tels.description.can-manage-the-co: Can manage the course team and all course settings.
authz.tels.description.can-publish-conte: Can publish content and manage the course lifecycle in Studio.
authz.tels.description.can-view-course-c: Can view course content and settings, but cannot make changes.
authz.tels.description.course-level-admi: course level administration, including access and role management for the course team, plus all Staff capabilities.
authz.tels.description.create-a-new-cour: Create a new course in Studio.
authz.tels.description.create-and-manage: Create and manage content groups used to target course content to specific learners.
authz.tels.description.create-edit-and-d: Create, edit, and delete course announcements and handouts.
Create, edit, and delete tags on this course.
Create, edit, and delete tags on this library.
Create, edit, and delete taxonomies used to organize course content.
authz.tels.description.create-new-collec: Create new collections to organize content within the library.
Create new collections within a library.
authz.tels.description.create-new-conten: Create new content items in the library.
authz.tels.description.delete-entire-col: Delete entire collections from the library.
authz.tels.description.download-the-cour: Download the course content as a file for backup or reuse in another platform.
authz.tels.description.download-the-tag-: Download the tag data associated with this course.
authz.tels.description.edit-course-conte: Edit course content, outline, units, components.
authz.tels.description.edit-course-detai: Edit course details, includes Course Summary, Course Pacing, Course Details, Course Pre requisite.
authz.tels.description.edit-course-team-: Edit course team membership and roles.
authz.tels.description.edit-existing-con: Edit existing content items in the library.
authz.tels.description.edit-pages-and-re: Edit Pages and Resources, including toggles and content managed from that section.
authz.tels.description.edit-the-course-o: Edit the course outline, units, and components.
authz.tels.description.enable-or-disable: Enable or disable course features such as Discussions, the Wiki, Notes, Calculator, and Live. Create and edit Textbooks and Custom pages, and manage their configurations.
authz.tels.description.import-content-fr: Import content from an existing course into this library.
authz.tels.description.import-course-con: Import course content from a file. This is a high-privilege action that can overwrite most course content and settings.
authz.tels.description.manage-course-upd: Manage course updates and handouts, create, edit, delete.
authz.tels.description.non-destructive-f: Non destructive file actions, for example lock or unlock, exact actions depend on implementation.
authz.tels.description.operating-the-cou: operating the course lifecycle in Studio, publishing content, handling scheduling, and managing high impact configuration for the course.
authz.tels.description.permanently-remov: Permanently remove collections from the library.
Permanently remove content items from the library.
Permanently remove files and assets from the course.
authz.tels.description.permissions-for-c: Permissions for creating and managing content collections within the library.
Permissions for creating, editing, deleting, and publishing content within the library.
authz.tels.description.permissions-for-i: Permissions for importing and exporting course content and related data.
authz.tels.description.permissions-for-m: Permissions for managing advanced course settings and course certificates.
Permissions for managing tags and taxonomies used to organize course content.
authz.tels.description.permissions-for-r: Permissions for reviewing and managing updates made to content libraries connected to the course.
authz.tels.description.permissions-for-v: Permissions for viewing and editing the course schedule and course information.
Permissions for viewing and managing course pages and additional learning resources.
Permissions for viewing and managing course updates and handouts that are visible to learners.
Permissions for viewing and managing the course team, learner groups, and group configurations.
Permissions for viewing and managing users who have access to the library.
authz.tels.description.permissions-relat: Permissions related to accessing the course and managing core course content, including creating, editing, and publishing materials.
Permissions related to the library as a whole.
Permissions related to viewing and managing grading configuration and grading policies.
Permissions related to viewing, managing, and publishing the library structure and metadata.
authz.tels.description.permissions-to-cr: Permissions to create, edit, and delete content collections within the library.
Permissions to create, edit, delete, and publish individual content items within the library.
authz.tels.description.permissions-to-ma: Permissions to manage user access and roles within the library.
authz.tels.description.publish-content-m: Publish content, making it available for reuse
authz.tels.description.publish-individua: Publish individual content items to make them available for reuse in courses.
authz.tels.description.publish-the-libra: Publish the library to make it available for use in courses.
authz.tels.description.qa-compliance-rev: QA, compliance review, content review, and general oversight, no changes in Studio.
authz.tels.description.reuse-published-c: Reuse published content within a course.
authz.tels.description.see-course-announ: See course announcements and handouts visible to learners.
authz.tels.description.see-course-inform: See course information including the course summary, pacing, and prerequisites.
authz.tels.description.see-the-course-la: See the course launch checklist in Studio.
authz.tels.description.see-the-course-st: See the course start and end dates, enrollment dates, and pacing settings.
authz.tels.description.see-the-grading-c: See the grading configuration for the course, including assignment types and grading scale.
authz.tels.description.see-the-list-of-f: See the list of files and assets uploaded to the course.
authz.tels.description.see-the-list-of-u: See the list of users with a role assigned to this course.
See the list of users with a role assigned to this library.
See the list of users with platform-wide roles such as Global Staff and Super Admin.
authz.tels.description.see-the-pages-res: See the Pages & Resources section in Studio.
authz.tels.description.show-import-in-st: Show Import in Studio, this is treated as a high privilege action and effectively implies most authoring permissions.
authz.tels.description.the-library-admin: The Library Admin has full control over the library, including managing users, modifying content, and handling publishing workflows. They ensure content is properly maintained and accessible as needed.
authz.tels.description.the-library-autho: The Library Author is responsible for creating, editing, and publishing content within a library. They can manage tags and collections but cannot delete libraries or manage users.
authz.tels.description.the-library-contr: The Library Contributor can create and edit content within a library but cannot publish it. They support the authoring process while leaving final publishing to Authors or Admins.
authz.tels.description.the-library-user-: The Library User can view and reuse content but cannot edit or delete any resource.
The Library User can view and reuse content but cannot edit or delete anything.
authz.tels.description.update-course-inf: Update course information including the course summary, pacing, and prerequisites.
authz.tels.description.update-course-sta: Update course start and end dates, enrollment dates, and pacing settings.
authz.tels.description.update-the-gradin: Update the grading configuration for the course, including assignment types and grading scale.
authz.tels.description.update-the-name-a: Update the name and contents of existing collections.
authz.tels.description.upload-new-files-: Upload new files and assets to the course.
authz.tels.description.view-content-sear: View content, search, filter, and sort within the library.
authz.tels.description.view-course-in-th: View course in the course list, access the course outline in read only mode, includes the "View Live" entry point.
authz.tels.description.view-course-see-t: View course: See the course in the Studio home and access the course outline in read-only mode. Includes the "View Live" option to preview the course as a learner in the LMS.
authz.tels.description.view-see-the-libr: View: See the library in Studio and access its content in read-only mode.
authz.tels.description.view-the-list-of-: View the list of users who have access to the library.
